# Third-party 3D animal assets

- `quaternius-fox.glb` and `quaternius-shiba.glb`: Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animal Pack, CC0 1.0. Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html
- Binary files were copied from https://github.com/lhns/steam-frame-nix/tree/main/modules/pet/models/ (see its CREDITS.md for adaptation details). These may contain adaptations made by the upstream repository. Preserve source attribution and check upstream credits when redistributing.
- These are low-poly animated game assets, not photorealistic or high-detail characters.
- Only fox is enabled in the current student scene; shiba is stored as a future optional character asset. Other character types retain existing procedural fallback.
